# Case converter

Convert each line to camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, Title case….

Category: Text · ID: `case` · Search terms: camel, pascal, snake, kebab, constant, title, upper, lower

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui case [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--to` | `camel`, `pascal`, `snake`, `kebab`, `constant`, `dot`, `title`, `sentence`, `lower`, `upper` | `camel` | To. |
| `--split-digits` | on/off | `true` | Split digits. Treat digits as separate words: HTTPServer2 → http_server_2 |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/case`), so they are what the tool prints.

### identifiers-camel

Input:

```text
HTTPServer2
user_id
  getUserByID
parse-xml-document
SOME_CONSTANT_VALUE
hello world, again
École élémentaire

v2ApiClient
```

Output:

```text
httpServer2
userId
  getUserById
parseXmlDocument
someConstantValue
helloWorldAgain
écoleÉlémentaire

v2ApiClient
```
